values.meaning: mana cost refund on champion hit
values.binNote: wiki's 40% mana refund text matches only the first rank of ChampRefund [0.4/0.425/0.45/0.475/0.5], described in prose as a flat 40% though the leveling table shows it scaling to 50%; likely the prose is unrounded/rank-1-only wording while the actual value uses the same array as the cooldown refund.

values.quote: knocking them up and stunning them for 1 second

values.meaning: delay from channel completion to blink/damage
values.binNote: wiki's 0.15s post-channel delay equals AoEDelayFromChannelStart (1.5) minus ChannelTime (1.35).

values.meaning: lockout duration after blink before Tahm Kench can act
values.quote: remains {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{fd|0.65}} seconds after the blink
values.binNote: wiki's 0.65s lockout equals TotalTime (2) minus AoEDelayFromChannelStart (1.5).

mechanics.claim: Tahm Kench blinks to the target location after the channel, dealing damage, knock up, and stun to nearby enemies upon landing, not during the channel.
mechanics.quote: Upon completion of the channel, '''Tahm Kench''' {{tip|blink|blinks}} to the target location after a {{fd|0.15}}-second delay, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: If at least one enemy champion is hit by the emergence, a cooldown and mana refund is granted; against a single dummy target this refund applies.
mechanics.quote: If at least one enemy {{tip|champion}} is hit, 40% of ''Abyssal Dive's'' {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost as well as a percentage of its {{sti|cooldown}} are refunded.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown starts on cast, not on the delayed damage.
The ability can be blocked by a spell shield.
